collection.description: The researchers imagine a tool that becomes better at weaving by observing a master instead of following a fixed sequence.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The researchers imagine a tool that becomes better at weaving by observing a master instead of following a fixed sequence.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: An imagined apprentice-machine copies the pattern and also copies the teacher's mistake.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A weaver asks who receives credit for a pattern learned from generations of human hands.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The machine proposes an unfamiliar weave; the artisans debate whether novelty is creativity.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A hypothetical experiment wastes precious fiber, reminding everyone that learning has costs.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A child says learning is changing after experience.

text_only.reason: "experience" / "skill" in the everyday sense (what a person has lived through or can do), not a skill gain

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A philosopher asks whether changing behavior proves understanding; the group cannot settle it.
